description: This file defines a React component called DataTable, which renders a customizable, paginated, sortable data table with sticky headers and optional server-side data fetching. It includes functions for measuring text width for dynamic column sizing, manages internal state for sorting and pagination, and renders table headers, body, and pagination controls with accessibility features.

methods.name: measureTextWidth
methods.description: Calculates the width of a given text string using an off-screen canvas for dynamic column width sizing, with a fallback to character count if canvas is unavailable.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves a nested value from a data object based on a dot-separated path string.

methods.name: setPageAndNotify
methods.description: Sets the current page, triggers data fetch if in server mode, and scrolls the table body to top.

methods.name: toggleSort
methods.description: Handles sorting logic when a column header is clicked, toggling sort direction or setting a new sort key, and fetching data in server mode.

methods.name: onBodyScroll
methods.description: Adds or removes a CSS class to the header to indicate scroll state, providing visual feedback.

methods.name: PaginationControls
methods.description: A React component rendering pagination buttons and controls, including page navigation, jump input, and accessibility features.
